mapper.sql: id, shop_id, setting_id, trigger_date, plan_time, content, week_days, repeat_mode, status, target_count, truncated_count, shard_count, success_count, fail_count, skip_reason, planned_at, started_at, finished_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mt_im_broadcast_task ( shop_id, setting_id, trigger_date, plan_time, content, week_days, repeat_mode, status, target_count, truncated_count, shard_count, success_count, fail_count, skip_reason, planned_at, started_at, finished_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{shopId}, #{settingId}, #{triggerDate}, #{planTime}, #{content}, #{weekDays}, #{repeatMode}, #{status}, #{targetCount}, #{truncatedCount}, #{shardCount}, #{successCount}, #{failCount}, #{skipReason}, #{plannedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mt_im_broadcast_task WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE mt_im_broadcast_task SET target_count = #{targetCount}, truncated_count = #{truncatedCount}, shard_count = #{shardCount}, status = 'SENDING', planned_at = #{plannedAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
